verdict.rationale: YYLO is a local CLI orchestrator. Agents work in local Git checkouts and worktrees, and delivery happens through YYLO's own local `merge land` flow with Git ref protection. Nothing in the evidence documents connecting a GitHub repository or having an agent open pull requests on it. The GitHub integration that is documented covers bringing GitHub issues into kanban, which is an adjacent feature, not repository connection or PR creation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect a GitHub repository so an agent can access the code and open pull requests against it
